about_short_description.short_description: Onex is a healthcare technology and medical business expansion platform.

product.name: Medical Onex Platform
product.description: A digital platform connecting medical manufacturers with distributors worldwide to facilitate business expansion and distribution partnerships.

product.name: Distributor Matching Service
product.description: A service that matches medical manufacturers with appropriate distributors based on manufacturer preferences and certifications.

product.name: Regulatory Affairs Support
product.description: A service providing regulatory compliance checks and support for medical manufacturers expanding into new markets.

product.name: Marketing Materials Creation
product.description: Creation of customized marketing videos and graphics designed to attract distributors and support manufacturer outreach.

product.name: Expansion Progress Reporting
product.description: Provision of detailed quarterly reports to track the progress of a manufacturer’s international expansion efforts.
